title: The Multiorbital Bivariate Chromatic Polynomial: A Subgroup-Lattice Refinement
summary: We introduce the multiorbital bivariate chromatic polynomial F_Γ(G;x,y) = \sum_{H\leq G}\frac{1}{|H|}\sum_{h\in H}P_{Γ/h}(x,y), which aggregates the orbital bivariate chromatic polynomials associated with all subgroups of a finite group acting on a graph. We derive the equivalent element-wise representation F_Γ(G;x,y) = \sum_{g\in G}c_G(g)P_{Γ/g}(x,y), where c_G(g) = \sum_{\langle g\rangle\leq H\leq G}\frac{1}{|H|}.
